about: Routine requirements per UCG T&T level (nf = New Flyers, if = Intermediate Flyers, hf = High Flyers), from the accepted text of the UCG T&T Code of Points v3.41. Own words; digest of levels.md. DD limits are inclusive ('max' = this value or lower, 'min' = this value or higher). cite = the Code's section numbers, which restart under each event (TR, SY, DMT, TU). 'pending' notes open v3.5 suggestions, which are not in force. The planner's js/scoring/tt.js holds the same limits today; it switches to this file through the bundle (ARCHITECTURE step 4).

requirement_penalty.applies_to: a routine that doesn't meet its level's requirements

tramp.pending: v3.5: HF two routines (best counts) and 3 touches

listed_saltos.note: up to 2 skills from this list may go over max_skill_dd

nf.repeats: a 0.0 skill may be repeated once; a skill above 0.0 may not be repeated
nf.pending: v3.5: position jumps also repeatable once; repeats earn no DD

repeat_penalty.applies_to: every repeat except the NF 0.0 repeats

dmt.roundoff_or_fhs_entry: allowed with a safety video approved in advance and a note on the card
dmt.repeat_rule: a skill repeated in the same position (mounter, spotter or dismount) earns no DD; it is not an interruption

if.min_skill_dd_exception: a rebound (0.1), in either or both passes
if.pass2_saltos: any number of handsprings and whips, but only 1 other salto, and it must be the dismount

tumbling.short_pass_start_value: an interrupted pass with at least the level's minimum skills (nf 4, if pass 1 5) still starts from 10.0 execution, with the 2.0 CJP penalty

repeats.other_skills: once more, with a different entry (twice in one pass or once in each pass, not both); more is an interruption
repeats.repeated_pass: must start the skill from a different entry
